title: Old Money
text: The gated estates of the North-West remember their friends. Hold the zone and the cheques write themselves.

title: The Pulpit
text: The North's revival tents seat thousands. Whoever holds the pulpit gets the collection plate and the amen.

title: Press Row
text: Every editor in the North-East owes someone a favour. Tomorrow's front page reaches you tonight.

title: Dockworkers' Union
text: The West's union marches whether you asked or not. Their banner has your face on it now.

title: The Capital
text: Every corridor in the Center leaks. Hold the ministries and the files find their way to your desk.

title: Broadcast Hill
text: The East's towers decide who exists this news cycle. Spike a story; run a different one.

title: The Badlands
text: Nothing moves through the South-West without a toll. Your people lean on a rival's convoy.

title: Restive South
text: The South never wanted a ruler. Holding it means paying for the privilege, every single week.

title: The Docks
text: The South-East's patronage machine never sleeps: a job, a favour, a vote. Seat a loyalist anywhere.
